messages.subject: Marie | Energy & Renewables Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Marie,

Your retained-search work across Energy, Renewables, EPC, Industrial and international leadership assignments makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior mandates where energy transition, institutional relationships and responsible growth intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness. This gives me direct exposure to the institutional, regulatory and sustainability dimensions of large-scale industrial energy transition.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership in energy, renewables, infrastructure, mining and industrial businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to North America, the Middle East, Europe and other global assignments.

I have attached an EMA Partners-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
